kv.fr: Reprendre les réglages de la borne de recharge enregistrés avant que la plateforme ne les garde.
kv.en: Imports the charging spot settings saved before the platform kept them.

platform.fr: Vérifier que le module est activé et complet avant de montrer la borne de recharge au voyageur.
platform.en: Checks the module is enabled and complete before showing the charging spot to the guest.

reveal:charger_pin:guest_pre_arrival.fr: Montrer au voyageur, avant son arrivée, le code ou badge de la borne de recharge.
reveal:charger_pin:guest_pre_arrival.en: Shows the guest the charger's code or badge before arrival.

reveal:charger_pin:guest_stay.fr: Montrer au voyageur, pendant son séjour, le code ou badge de la borne de recharge.
reveal:charger_pin:guest_stay.en: Shows the guest the charger's code or badge during the stay.

reveal:parking_code:guest_pre_arrival.fr: Montrer au voyageur, avant son arrivée, le code de la barrière de l'emplacement de recharge.
reveal:parking_code:guest_pre_arrival.en: Shows the guest the barrier code of the charging spot before arrival.

reveal:parking_code:guest_stay.fr: Montrer au voyageur, pendant son séjour, le code de la barrière de l'emplacement de recharge.
reveal:parking_code:guest_stay.en: Shows the guest the barrier code of the charging spot during the stay.
